description:
Log a bug in the same inbox as the terminal bug button (5 per user per day).

    Use only when the user asks, or when you have confirmed a real data/UI
    error. Do not file speculative bugs. Pass ticker/section so admins get a
    terminal URL; page_url is optional if it is already a terminal.manawa.app link.
    Prefer block_id (registry.ui_blocks id) when the bug is tied to a page
    element; include item_ids and developer_note when known.

    Args:
        description: What is wrong (10–2000 characters)
        ticker: Optional stock symbol the bug is about
        section: Optional tab (overview, financials, thesis, valuation, …)
        page_url: Optional full terminal URL if already known
        block_id: Optional registry.ui_blocks id for the page element
        item_ids: Optional provenance / store item ids related to the bug
        developer_note: Optional note for developers (repro steps, flags, etc.)

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: report_bug
title: Report a bug
